name: binance_spot-mcp
description: Binance Spot (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles, get_balances, list_orders, place_

platform_mcp_binance_spot_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_SPOT_API_KEY
platform_mcp_binance_spot_api_key.description: Binance API key (sent as X-MBX-APIKEY). Create it under API Management with withdrawals OFF; restrict it to your IP. For the spot testnet create a separate key at https://testnet.binance.vision and point adapter.base_url at https://testnet.binance.vision (the testnet key does not work on api.binance.com and vice versa).

platform_mcp_binance_spot_api_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_SPOT_API_SECRET
platform_mcp_binance_spot_api_secret.description: The key's HMAC secret: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the exact query string, appended as `signature` after `timestamp`). Never sent on the wire.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Signed GET /api/v3/account (weight 20): returns canTrade, canWithdraw, permissions and non-zero balances. The key should show canWithdraw only if withdrawals were left enabled, which you should not do.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Public, sent unsigned (Binance rejects extra timestamp/signature parameters on market data with -1104). Weight 20; every spot symbol in one response (no pagination; `query` is not sent).

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Public, sent unsigned. Weight 2 for one symbol; decimal strings passed through.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Public, sent unsigned. Weight 2. Intervals 1s,1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,8h,12h,1d,3d,1w,1M; positional rows oldest first, `time` = open time in ms, prices as decimal strings. Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

tools.name: get_balances
tools.description: Weight 20. Zero balances are omitted; amounts are decimal strings.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Open orders only (weight 6 with a symbol, 80 without). `status` is not sent: closed orders need GET /api/v3/allOrders, which is not mapped.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the spot testnet https://testnet.binance.vision first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. Market orders spend `quantity` of the base asset; limit orders are sent with timeInForce=GTC and need `price` (omit `price` for market orders). quantity and price are sent as decimal strings and must respect the symbol's LOT_SIZE/PRICE_FILTER.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Binance requires `symbol` together with the order id.
